friendly_name: Keep a project-local Codex home ignored after agent-gitignore narrowing (#7729)
purpose_context: Projects that followed Spec Kitty's earlier advice to set CODEX_HOME to the project's .codex/ folder had their Codex session databases, state, config and approval rules turned into untracked files by the 4.0.0rc8 agent-gitignore narrowing, so a git add -A could commit personal Codex state. Only the clone that ran the upgrade saw a warning. This Mission keeps that state ignored and protects and warns every clone.
purpose_tldr: Stop the rc8 agent-gitignore narrowing from exposing personal Codex home state, and warn every clone, not only the one that upgraded.
